case_study_packaging.headline: $1.2M run-rate savings across 10 categories
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: APDerm faced decentralized purchasing and fragmented vendor relationships that did not leverage the company's full enterprise-wide purchasing power.
approach_summary: Conducted a comprehensive spend analysis across categories
Leveraged GPOs and incumbent negotiations for cost reduction
Implemented strategic sourcing with competitive RFPs
Collaborated with stakeholders to ensure sustainable savings
Retained incumbent suppliers where possible to minimize disruptions
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Delivered a 19% cost reduction, enhancing procurement efficiency and maintaining service quality.
where_we_were_unique: Culturally sensitive approach with aggressive but soft-touch negotiations
